editorial:
Imagine waking up one morning and suddenly losing your sight, with no warning and no cure in sight. That is the terrifying setup of this gripping drama, where a strange plague of blindness sweeps through a city and turns everyday life into chaos. You follow a small group of people who are locked away in a rundown quarantine facility, trying to survive as food runs low and tempers flare. Julianne Moore plays a woman who secretly keeps her sight, and her quiet strength becomes the heart of the story as she tries to protect the people around her. The film has a raw, unsettling vibe that pulls you in and makes you feel the fear and confusion of the characters.

The acting is strong across the board, especially from Moore, and the pacing keeps you tense even when not much is happening on screen. The downside is that the movie can feel heavy and bleak, and some scenes are hard to watch. Still, if you enjoy dark, thought-provoking thrillers that ask big questions about human nature, this one is worth your time. Stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, rent it on Apple TV, or grab the 4K Blu-ray for the best picture quality.
endingExplained: In the final scenes, the woman who can still see leads her group out of the filthy quarantine facility after the guards abandon them. They wander through a city where everyone is now blind, struggling to find food and shelter. Eventually, just as suddenly as it began, people start regaining their sight one by one. The woman's husband is among the last to recover, and the film ends with the group together, grateful and changed, as the world slowly returns to normal.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves dark survival thrillers and stories about human nature under pressure.
